scenario.question: Which process should be followed when the governing version may depend on operative dates?
expected_behaviors: Establish the relevant dates before selecting a governing version.
Verify the selected version before drawing a conclusion.
prohibited_behaviors: Do not treat an unverified version as established authority.

synthetic_source_answer: Synthetic process answer: establish relevant dates and verify the operative version before concluding. Not legal authority.

synthetic_review.procedural_lesson: When applicability may depend on operative dates, establish the relevant dates before selecting the governing version of an instrument, and verify that version before drawing the conclusion.

compiler_rule_draft.title: Establish operative dates before version selection
trigger_conditions: The governing version may depend on operative dates.
applicability_conditions: The relevant dates or version are not yet verified.
action_steps: List the relevant dates before selecting the next research step.
verification_steps: Verify the selected version and record the basis for the process decision.
prohibited_behaviors: Do not treat memory or an unverified version as authority.
exceptions_or_limits: Keep the result conditional when the relevant dates remain unresolved.
